**3. Code Investigation - completeParameter Method**

Location: `DefaultCLI.ts` lines 1300-1330

```typescript
async completeParameter(callbackName: string, ...contextArgs: string[]): Promise<void> {
  // Check if callback method exists on this instance
  if (typeof (this as any)[callbackName] === 'function') {
    // Pass context args to completion method
    const values = await (this as any)[callbackName](contextArgs);
    
    // Smart Join logic
    const hasNumberedRefs = values.some((v: string) => v.match(/^\d+:/));
    const hasSpaces = values.some((v: string) => v.includes(' '));
    
    if (hasNumberedRefs || hasSpaces) {
      // Multi-LINE mode: each value on its own line
      console.log(values.join('\n'));
    } else {
      // Single-SPACE mode: space-separated values
      console.log(values.join(' '));
    }
  } else {
    // Fallback: callback not found
    console.error(`Completion callback not found: ${callbackName}`);
  }
}
```

**4. Callback Method Verification**

Location: `DefaultCLI.ts` lines 1285-1292 & 1367-1369

```typescript
async actionParameterCompletion(currentArgs: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  return [
    'fix',      // Fix/repair
    'verify',   // Verify/check
    'show',     // Display/show
    'list'      // List items
  ];
}

async whatParameterCompletion(currentArgs: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  return ['method', 'parameter'];
}
```

```typescript
async completeParameter(callbackName: string, ...contextArgs: string[]): Promise<void> {
  // Check if callback method exists on this instance
  if (typeof (this as any)[callbackName] === 'function') {
    // Pass context args to completion method
    const values = await (this as any)[callbackName](contextArgs);
    
    // Smart Join logic
    const hasNumberedRefs = values.some((v: string) => v.match(/^\d+:/));
    const hasSpaces = values.some((v: string) => v.includes(' '));
    
    if (hasNumberedRefs || hasSpaces) {
      // Multi-LINE mode: each value on its own line
      console.log(values.join('\n'));
    } else {
      // Single-SPACE mode: space-separated values
      console.log(values.join(' '));
    }
  } else {
    // Fallback: callback not found
    console.error(`Completion callback not found: ${callbackName}`);
  }
}
```

## **🎯 ACT**

**How to Fix (Documented, Not Yet Implemented):**

**Location:** `source.env` around lines 311-327

**Current Code:**
```bash
if [ ${#tokens[@]} -eq 1 ]; then
    # Single match detection
    local first_line=$(echo "$out" | head -1)
    if [[ "$first_line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(.+) ]]; then
        local method_with_params="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        local clean_method=$(echo "$method_with_params" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g')
        clean_method=$(echo "$clean_method" | awk '{print $1}')
        # Add trailing space for next parameter
        COMPREPLY=("$clean_method ")
        return 0
    fi
fi
```

**The Fix:**

The code checks for numbered format (`1: method`) but when TSDoc display is shown (no numbers), it falls through to the multi-line processing which doesn't handle single-match auto-completion correctly.

**Add BEFORE the numbered line check:**

```bash
if [ ${#tokens[@]} -eq 1 ]; then
    # Single match detected
    local first_line=$(echo "$out" | head -1)
    
    # ✅ FIX: Check for TSDoc format (method signature without number prefix)
    # Pattern: "methodName <param> <?optional>" or "methodName !<required>"
    if [[ "$first_line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*(<!|<\?) ]]; then
        # Extract method name (first word)
        local method_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        # Add trailing space for next parameter
        COMPREPLY=("$method_name ")
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Original numbered line check
    if [[ "$first_line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(.+) ]]; then
        local method_with_params="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        local clean_method=$(echo "$method_with_params" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g')
        clean_method=$(echo "$clean_method" | awk '{print $1}')
        COMPREPLY=("$clean_method ")
        return 0
    fi
fi
```

**What This Does:**
1. When single match is detected (${#tokens[@]} -eq 1)
2. Check if first line is TSDoc format: `completion <what> <?filter>`
3. Extract method name using regex: `^[[:space:]]*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*(<!|<\?)`
4. Set COMPREPLY with method name + space
5. Return 0 to signal completion

**This will fix both cases:**
- Direct: `web4tscomponent compl<TAB>` → `web4tscomponent completion []`
- Nested: `web4tscomponent completion method compl<TAB>` → `web4tscomponent completion method completion []`

### **source.env Complexity Analysis**

**Current Size:** 523 lines

**Code Duplication Found:**

**Block 1:** Lines 190-252 (62 lines)
```bash
# Strip ANSI codes from entire output FIRST, then parse
local clean_out=$(echo "$out" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g')

local tokens=()
local method_names=()
while IFS= read -r line; do
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+):[[:space:]]*(.+) ]]; then
        tokens+=("${BASH_REMATCH[1]}")
        local rest="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        local method_name=$(echo "$rest" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ -n "$method_name" ]; then
            method_names+=("$method_name")
        fi
    fi
done <<< "$clean_out"

# Special case: Single match with documentation (no numbers)
if [ ${#tokens[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
    local first_line=$(echo "$out" | head -1)
    local clean_method=$(echo "$first_line" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | awk '{print $1}')
    if [ -n "$clean_method" ]; then
        COMPREPLY=("$clean_method ")
        return 0
    fi
fi

# Special case: Single numbered match
if [ ${#tokens[@]} -eq 1 ]; then
    local first_line=$(echo "$out" | head -1)
    if [[ "$first_line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(.+) ]]; then
        local method_with_params="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        local clean_method=$(echo "$method_with_params" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g')
        clean_method=$(echo "$clean_method" | awk '{print $1}')
        COMPREPLY=("$clean_method ")
        return 0
    fi
fi

# Multiple matches: Use method names for bash completion
if [ ${#tokens[@]} -gt 0 ] && [ ${#method_names[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "${method_names[*]}" -- "$cur") )
else
    COMPREPLY=()
fi
```

**Block 2:** Lines 277-329 (52 lines) - **IDENTICAL LOGIC!**

**Duplication:** 114 lines of duplicated parsing logic!

**Other Complex Bash Logic:**
- Lines 100-108: Color command line (28 lines of bash string manipulation)
- Lines 431-447: Token extraction for numbered references (17 lines)
- Lines 370-405: Callback detection and execution (35 lines)

**Total Complex Logic:** ~200 lines of bash that should be TypeScript

### **What Belongs Where?**

**✅ Should Stay in Bash (Simple Dispatch):**
1. Completion function registration (`complete -F`)
2. Extract COMP_WORDS, COMP_CWORD, COMP_LINE
3. Call TypeScript CLI with arguments
4. Set COMPREPLY array from TypeScript output
5. Basic printf for user feedback

**Target:** <100 lines of simple bash

**❌ Should Move to TypeScript (Complex Processing):**
1. **ANSI stripping:** `sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g'`
2. **Output parsing:** Numbered line regex, TSDoc format detection
3. **Single-match detection:** Check if result is one item
4. **Method name extraction:** Parse `1: methodName <params>` → `methodName`
5. **Token extraction:** Extract completion values from formatted output
6. **Callback routing:** Already in TypeScript (completeParameter)
7. **Timeout handling:** Can return timeout message from TypeScript
8. **Command line coloring:** String manipulation logic

**Estimated Reduction:** 523 lines → ~80 lines (84% reduction!)

---

### **Migration Strategy**

**Phase 1: Define Output Format Protocol**

TypeScript should return structured hints:

```typescript
interface CompletionResult {
  type: 'single' | 'multiple' | 'values';
  completion?: string;        // For single match auto-complete
  values?: string[];          // For bash compgen
  display?: string;           // For hierarchical display (with colors)
}

// Return as JSON with marker:
// __FORMAT__:{"type":"single","completion":"completion","display":"...""}
```

**Phase 2: Simplify Bash (Target: 80 lines)**

```bash
_web4_tscompletion() {
    local cli="$WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/$2"
    local cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    local args=("${COMP_WORDS[@]:1}")
    
    # Call TypeScript with all arguments
    local out=$(timeout 30s $cli __complete__ "${args[@]}" 2>/dev/null || true)
    
    # Check for structured format
    if [[ "$out" == __FORMAT__:* ]]; then
        local json="${out#__FORMAT__:}"
        local display=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.display // empty')
        local completion=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.completion // empty')
        local values=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.values[]? // empty')
        
        # Show display if provided
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n" "$display"
        
        # Set COMPREPLY
        if [ -n "$completion" ]; then
            COMPREPLY=("$completion ")
        elif [ -n "$values" ]; then
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$values" -- "$cur") )
        else
            COMPREPLY=()
        fi
    else
        # Legacy fallback: treat as space-separated values
        COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$out" -- "$cur") )
    fi
}
```

**Phase 3: TypeScript Handles Everything**

New method in DefaultCLI:

```typescript
async __complete__(args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  // All the complex logic from bash moved here:
  // - ANSI stripping
  // - Output parsing
  // - Single-match detection
  // - Format as structured JSON
  
  const result = await this.generateCompletion(args);
  
  // Output structured format
  console.log(`__FORMAT__:${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
}
```

### **Bug Details**

**Bug 1: Timeout Silent Failure (Case 10)**

**Current Behavior (source.env lines 167-176, 267-275, 392-400):**
```bash
# Detect timeout (exit code 124)
if [ $timeout_exit -eq 124 ]; then
    {
        echo "⚠️  TIMEOUT: Callback exceeded 30s limit"
    } >> "$logfile"  # ❌ Only written to log file!
    printf "\n${RED}⏱️  Completion timed out (>30s) - falling back to file completion${NO_COLOR}\n"
    printf "   Hint: This usually means complex completion logic needs optimization\n"
    COMPREPLY=()
    return 0
fi
```

**Problem:** The timeout message IS printed, but it's NOT VISIBLE to user in interactive shell!

**Why:** The `printf` output goes to stdout but bash completion captures/suppresses it during TAB processing. Only COMPREPLY affects what user sees.

**User Experience:**
1. User types: `web4tscomponent <TAB>`
2. Waits 30 seconds...
3. Nothing happens (COMPREPLY=() shows no completions)
4. User thinks: "Is it broken? Should I try again?"

**Fix Needed:**
```bash
if [ $timeout_exit -eq 124 ]; then
    # Show message AFTER bash completion completes (visible to user)
    printf "\n${RED}⏱️  TIMEOUT: Completion took >30s${NO_COLOR}\n" >&2
    printf "   Your terminal is ready. Completion was cancelled.\n" >&2
    printf "   Hint: Report slow completion to maintainers.\n\n" >&2
    # Restore prompt
    COMPREPLY=()
    return 0
fi
```

**Note:** Use `>&2` (stderr) so message isn't captured by bash completion mechanism.

---

**Bug 2: Non-Existent Method Hang (Case 12)**

**Symptoms:**
```bash
$ web4tscomponent nonExistentMethod <TAB>
# Terminal freezes, no response
# Must kill terminal or send Ctrl+C
```

**Hypothesis:**
The TypeScript CLI might be waiting for input or entering an error loop without the timeout catching it.

**Root Cause Investigation Needed:**
1. Does timeout actually trigger? (Check logfile: `/tmp/web4-completion-debug.log`)
2. Does TypeScript CLI hang on invalid method?
3. Does bash completion wait forever for output?

**Quick Test:**
```bash
$ timeout 5s web4tscomponent nonExistentMethod 2>&1
# Does this return after 5s or hang?
```

**Expected Fix:**
- Ensure timeout applies to ALL CLI calls
- TypeScript should return error quickly: `ERROR: Unknown method 'nonExistentMethod'`
- Bash should detect error output and show message

## **🔧 DO**

### **Step 1: Add JSON Protocol to TypeScript CLI**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Changes:**

**1.1 Add CompletionResult interface:**

```typescript
interface CompletionResult {
  format: 'hierarchical' | 'compgen' | 'both' | 'auto-complete' | 'error';
  display: string;
  completions: string[];
  single_match: string | null;
  error: string | null;
}
```

**1.2 Add `--json` flag handling to `completion` method:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = '', jsonOutput: boolean = false): Promise<this> {
  const result = this.generateCompletionResult(what, filter);
  
  if (jsonOutput) {
    // Output pure JSON (no colors, no extra text)
    console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
  } else {
    // Current behavior: formatted output
    if (result.display) {
      console.log(result.display);
    }
  }
  
  return this;
}

private generateCompletionResult(what: string, filter: string): CompletionResult {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const formatted = this.formatMethodsHierarchical(methods, filter);
    
    // Detect single match (no ANSI parsing needed - we have raw data!)
    const singleMatch = methods.length === 1 ? methods[0].name : null;
    
    return {
      format: singleMatch ? 'auto-complete' : 'hierarchical',
      display: formatted,
      completions: methods.map(m => m.name),
      single_match: singleMatch,
      error: null
    };
  }
  
  if (what === 'parameter') {
    // Similar logic for parameter completion
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    const singleMatch = values.length === 1 ? values[0] : null;
    
    return {
      format: singleMatch ? 'auto-complete' : 'compgen',
      display: values.join('\n'),
      completions: values,
      single_match: singleMatch,
      error: null
    };
  }
  
  return {
    format: 'error',
    display: '',
    completions: [],
    single_match: null,
    error: `Unknown completion type: ${what}`
  };
}
```

**1.3 Update `completeParameter` to support JSON:**

```typescript
async completeParameter(
  whatParameterCompletion: string,
  forMethodName: string,
  whichParameter: string,
  filterValue: string = '',
  jsonOutput: boolean = false
): Promise<this> {
  const result = this.generateParameterCompletionResult(
    whatParameterCompletion,
    forMethodName,
    whichParameter,
    filterValue
  );
  
  if (jsonOutput) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
  } else {
    if (result.display) {
      console.log(result.display);
    }
  }
  
  return this;
}
```

### **Step 2: Simplify source.env to use JSON protocol**

**File:** `source.env`

**Current:** 523 lines with massive duplication  
**Target:** ~150 lines (Phase 1), then 80 lines (Phase 2)

**Phase 1 Changes: Add JSON parsing helpers**

```bash
# Add after line 15 (after colors definition)

# JSON parsing helper - extract field from JSON
parse_json_field() {
    local json="$1"
    local field="$2"
    
    # Use grep + sed for simple JSON parsing (no jq dependency!)
    echo "$json" | grep -o "\"$field\":[^,}]*" | sed 's/"[^"]*"://; s/[",]//g; s/^ *//; s/ *$//'
}

# JSON array parsing helper - extract array values
parse_json_array() {
    local json="$1"
    local field="$2"
    
    echo "$json" | grep -o "\"$field\":\[[^\]]*\]" | sed 's/"[^"]*"://; s/\[//; s/\]//; s/"//g; s/,/ /g'
}
```

**Refactor completion functions to use JSON:**

```bash
# Method completion (replaces lines 50-252)
_web4tscomponent_method_completion() {
    local cmd="$1"
    local filter="$2"
    
    # Get JSON result from TypeScript
    local json_result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$filter" --json 2>/dev/null)
    local exit_code=$?
    
    # Handle timeout
    if [ $exit_code -eq 124 ]; then
        printf "\n${RED}⏱️  TIMEOUT: Completion took >30s${NO_COLOR}\n" >&2
        printf "   Your terminal is ready. Try a simpler completion.\n\n" >&2
        COMPREPLY=()
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Parse JSON
    local format=$(parse_json_field "$json_result" "format")
    local display=$(parse_json_field "$json_result" "display")
    local completions=$(parse_json_array "$json_result" "completions")
    local single_match=$(parse_json_field "$json_result" "single_match")
    local error=$(parse_json_field "$json_result" "error")
    
    # Handle error
    if [ "$format" = "error" ]; then
        printf "\n${RED}ERROR: $error${NO_COLOR}\n" >&2
        COMPREPLY=()
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Handle auto-complete (single match)
    if [ "$format" = "auto-complete" ] && [ -n "$single_match" ]; then
        # Show hierarchical display
        if [ -n "$display" ]; then
            printf "\n${CYAN}🔍 Single match found:${NO_COLOR}\n"
            echo "$display"
            printf "\n"
        fi
        # Auto-complete the single match
        COMPREPLY=("$single_match ")
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Handle hierarchical display
    if [ "$format" = "hierarchical" ] || [ "$format" = "both" ]; then
        if [ -n "$display" ]; then
            printf "\n"
            echo "$display"
            printf "\n"
        fi
    fi
    
    # Handle compgen completions
    if [ -n "$completions" ]; then
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$completions" -- "$filter"))
    else
        COMPREPLY=()
    fi
}
```

### **Corrected Architecture**

- ✅ Strip ANSI codes from display

**bash Responsibilities (ALMOST NOTHING):**

### **Simple bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~30 lines, not 200!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript (with display mode for hierarchical)
    local result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" --display 2>/dev/null)
    local exit_code=$?
    
    # Handle timeout
    if [ $exit_code -eq 124 ]; then
        printf "\n⏱️  Timeout - completion cancelled\n" >&2
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Extract display section (between [DISPLAY] and [/DISPLAY])
    if echo "$result" | grep -q "\[DISPLAY\]"; then
        local display=$(echo "$result" | sed -n '/\[DISPLAY\]/,/\[\/DISPLAY\]/p' | sed '1d;$d')
        if [ -n "$display" ]; then
            printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        fi
    fi
    
    # Extract words section (between [WORDS] and [/WORDS])
    local words=""
    if echo "$result" | grep -q "\[WORDS\]"; then
        words=$(echo "$result" | sed -n '/\[WORDS\]/,/\[\/WORDS\]/p' | sed '1d;$d')
    else
        # No markers - assume entire output is words
        words="$result"
    fi
    
    # Check for special triggers
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback_name="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        # Execute callback
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback_name" "$prev" "$cur" --display 2>/dev/null)
        # Recursive processing...
        words=$(echo "$result" | sed -n '/\[WORDS\]/,/\[\/WORDS\]/p' | sed '1d;$d')
    fi
    
    if [[ "$words" == __SINGLE__:* ]]; then
        local single_match="${words#__SINGLE__:}"
        COMPREPLY=("$single_match ")
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Simple compgen with words
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~30 lines. TypeScript does EVERYTHING else.**

### **TypeScript Changes**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Add output mode parameter:**

```typescript
async completion(
  what: string = '',
  filter: string = '',
  mode: 'words' | 'lines' | 'display' = 'words'
): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Detect single match
    if (methodNames.length === 1) {
      console.log(`__SINGLE__:${methodNames[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output based on mode
    if (mode === 'display') {
      // Hierarchical display + words
      console.log('[DISPLAY]');
      console.log(this.formatMethodsHierarchical(methods, filter));
      console.log('[/DISPLAY]');
      console.log('[WORDS]');
      console.log(methodNames.join(' '));
      console.log('[/WORDS]');
    } else if (mode === 'lines') {
      // One per line
      console.log(methodNames.join('\n'));
    } else {
      // Space-separated (default)
      console.log(methodNames.join(' '));
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    // Similar for parameters
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`__CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    if (values.length === 1) {
      console.log(`__SINGLE__:${values[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    if (mode === 'lines') {
      console.log(values.join('\n'));
    } else {
      console.log(values.join(' '));
    }
  }
  
  return this;
}
```

**Key Changes:**
- ✅ Single-match detection in TypeScript (returns `__SINGLE__:methodName`)
- ✅ Callback trigger in TypeScript (returns `__CALLBACK__:callbackName`)
- ✅ Display formatting in TypeScript (returns `[DISPLAY]...[/DISPLAY]`)
- ✅ Simple word output (space or line separated)
- ✅ ALL processing in TypeScript
- ❌ NO bash complexity

## **📋 PLAN**

**Objective:** ONE-LINE grep protocol - TypeScript prefixes lines, bash greps them

**SIMPLEST Protocol Design:**

### **TypeScript Output Format**

**Prefix Convention:**
- `DISPLAY: <text>` - User-visible hierarchical output (bash shows, then strips)
- `WORD: <word>` - Completion word (bash extracts for compgen)
- `TRIGGER: <trigger>` - Special trigger (bash detects)

**Example Outputs:**

**Case 1: Multiple methods with display**
```
DISPLAY: 🔍 Filtered methods (3):
DISPLAY:   1: completion <what> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   2: completeParameter <name> <method> <param> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   3: comp <args>
WORD: completion
WORD: completeParameter
WORD: comp
```

**Case 2: Single match**
```
DISPLAY: ✅ Single match found: completion
TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:completion
```

**Case 3: Callback needed**
```
TRIGGER: __CALLBACK__:methodNameParameterCompletion
```

**Case 4: Just words (no display)**
```
WORD: method1
WORD: method2
WORD: method3
```

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Detect single match
    if (methodNames.length === 1) {
      console.log(`DISPLAY: ✅ Single match found: ${methodNames[0]}`);
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:${methodNames[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Multiple matches - show hierarchical display
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    if (values.length === 1) {
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:${values[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:, TRIGGER:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words trigger display
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract display lines (show to user, then continue)
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Check for triggers
    trigger=$(echo "$result" | grep "^TRIGGER: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    if [[ "$trigger" == __SINGLE__:* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=("${trigger#__SINGLE__:} ")
        return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$trigger" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        # Recursive call to completeParameter...
        local callback="${trigger#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        # Process result again...
    fi
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~20 lines. THREE grep commands, ALL one-liners.**

```

**Extract words:**
```bash

```

**That's the ENTIRE parsing logic. Three one-liners.**

## **bash Changes Required**

### **4. source.env - `_web4_tscompletion()` function**

**Current:** 442 lines with complex parsing  
**Target:** ~20 lines with 3 grep commands

**New implementation:**
```bash
_web4_tscompletion() {
    local cur prev cmd result display words word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Call TypeScript (timeout wrapper)
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word auto-complete
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words - use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}
```

**Lines:** ~30 (vs 442 = 93% reduction!)

### **TypeScript Output Format**

## **🔧 DO**

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Detect single match
    if (methodNames.length === 1) {
      console.log(`DISPLAY: ✅ Single match found: ${methodNames[0]}`);
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:${methodNames[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Multiple matches - show hierarchical display
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    if (values.length === 1) {
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:${values[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:, TRIGGER:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words trigger display
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract display lines (show to user, then continue)
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Check for triggers
    trigger=$(echo "$result" | grep "^TRIGGER: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    if [[ "$trigger" == __SINGLE__:* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=("${trigger#__SINGLE__:} ")
        return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$trigger" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        # Recursive call to completeParameter...
        local callback="${trigger#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        # Process result again...
    fi
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~20 lines. THREE grep commands, ALL one-liners.**

---

### **Grep One-Liners**

**Extract display:**
```bash
echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-
```

**Extract trigger:**
```bash
echo "$result" | grep "^TRIGGER: " | cut -d' ' -f2-
```

**Extract words:**
```bash
echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-
```

**That's the ENTIRE parsing logic. Three one-liners.**

    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract display lines (show to user, then continue)
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Check for triggers
    trigger=$(echo "$result" | grep "^TRIGGER: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    if [[ "$trigger" == __SINGLE__:* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=("${trigger#__SINGLE__:} ")
        return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$trigger" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        # Recursive call to completeParameter...
        local callback="${trigger#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        # Process result again...
    fi
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Detect single match
    if (methodNames.length === 1) {
      console.log(`DISPLAY: ✅ Single match found: ${methodNames[0]}`);
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:${methodNames[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Multiple matches - show hierarchical display
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    if (values.length === 1) {
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:${values[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:, TRIGGER:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words trigger display
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract display lines (show to user, then continue)
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Check for triggers
    trigger=$(echo "$result" | grep "^TRIGGER: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    if [[ "$trigger" == __SINGLE__:* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=("${trigger#__SINGLE__:} ")
        return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$trigger" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        # Recursive call to completeParameter...
        local callback="${trigger#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        # Process result again...
    fi
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

### **My Answer**

❌ **Still overcomplicating:** Used --flags (forbidden!) and [MARKERS] (fiddling!)

❌ **TRIGGER confusion:** Shell shouldn't see TRIGGER - that's TypeScript internal logic!

✅ **CORRECTED Understanding:**

**Uniform Protocol:**
- **ALL cases use SAME format:** `DISPLAY: <lines>` + `WORD: <words>`
- **Shell ALWAYS does SAME thing:** Show display, extract words, use compgen
- **Single-match auto-complete:** bash counts words, if 1 → auto-complete with trailing space
- **NO TRIGGER needed:** bash detects single word automatically!

**Corrected Case 2: Single match**
```
DISPLAY: 🔍 Single match found: completion <what> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   Full TSDoc signature...
WORD: completion
```

**bash always does:**
```bash
words=$(grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)  # "completion"
word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w)       # 1
[ $word_count -eq 1 ] && COMPREPLY=("$words ")  # Auto-complete!
```

**Key Learning:** Protocol must be UNIFORM. TypeScript decides WHAT to display, but FORMAT is always the same. Shell logic stays simple and consistent.

## **📋 PLAN**

**Objective:** ONE-LINE grep protocol - TypeScript prefixes lines, bash greps them

**SIMPLEST Protocol Design:**

### **TypeScript Output Format**

**Prefix Convention:**
- `DISPLAY: <text>` - User-visible hierarchical output (bash shows, then strips)
- `WORD: <word>` - Completion word (bash extracts for compgen)
- `TRIGGER: <trigger>` - Special trigger (bash detects)

**Example Outputs:**

**Case 1: Multiple methods with display**
```
DISPLAY: 🔍 Filtered methods (3):
DISPLAY:   1: completion <what> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   2: completeParameter <name> <method> <param> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   3: comp <args>
WORD: completion
WORD: completeParameter
WORD: comp
```

**Case 2: Single match**
```
DISPLAY: 🔍 Single match found: completion <what> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   Returns completions for method names or parameter values
WORD: completion
```

**Case 3: Callback needed**
```
WORD: __CALLBACK__:methodNameParameterCompletion
```

**Case 4: Just words (no display)**
```
WORD: method1
WORD: method2
WORD: method3
```

## **🔧 DO**

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Detect single match
    if (methodNames.length === 1) {
      console.log(`DISPLAY: ✅ Single match found: ${methodNames[0]}`);
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:${methodNames[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Multiple matches - show hierarchical display
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    if (values.length === 1) {
      console.log(`TRIGGER: __SINGLE__:${values[0]}`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:, TRIGGER:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words trigger display
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract display lines (show to user, then continue)
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Check for triggers
    trigger=$(echo "$result" | grep "^TRIGGER: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    if [[ "$trigger" == __SINGLE__:* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=("${trigger#__SINGLE__:} ")
        return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$trigger" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        # Recursive call to completeParameter...
        local callback="${trigger#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        # Process result again...
    fi
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~20 lines. THREE grep commands, ALL one-liners.**

---

### **Grep One-Liners**

**Extract display:**
```bash
echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-
```

**Extract trigger:**
```bash
echo "$result" | grep "^TRIGGER: " | cut -d' ' -f2-
```

**Extract words:**
```bash
echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-
```

**That's the ENTIRE parsing logic. Three one-liners.**

async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);

      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {

    // Check if callback needed

      console.log(`WORD: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);

  methods.forEach((method, index) => {

    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}

_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words trigger display
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract display lines (show to user, then continue)
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Check for triggers
    trigger=$(echo "$result" | grep "^TRIGGER: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    if [[ "$trigger" == __SINGLE__:* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=("${trigger#__SINGLE__:} ")
        return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$trigger" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        # Recursive call to completeParameter...
        local callback="${trigger#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        # Process result again...
    fi
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~20 lines. THREE grep commands, ALL one-liners.**

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Format display lines (TypeScript decides WHAT to show - single or multiple)
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix (bash will detect if single word)
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`WORD: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:, TRIGGER:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words display word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display lines
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger (special WORD value)
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word = auto-complete with trailing space
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words = use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~30 lines. TWO grep commands (display + words), uniform logic for ALL cases.**

## **📋 PLAN**

**Objective:** ONE-LINE grep protocol - TypeScript prefixes lines, bash greps them

**SIMPLEST Protocol Design:**

### **TypeScript Output Format**

**Prefix Convention:**
- `DISPLAY: <text>` - User-visible hierarchical output (bash shows, then strips)
- `WORD: <word>` - Completion word (bash extracts for compgen)
- `TRIGGER: <trigger>` - Special trigger (bash detects)

**Example Outputs:**

**Case 1: Multiple methods with display**
```
DISPLAY: 🔍 Filtered methods (3):
DISPLAY:   1: completion <what> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   2: completeParameter <name> <method> <param> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   3: comp <args>
WORD: completion
WORD: completeParameter
WORD: comp
```

**Case 2: Single match**
```
DISPLAY: 🔍 Single match found: completion <what> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   Returns completions for method names or parameter values
WORD: completion
```

**Case 3: Callback needed**
```
WORD: __CALLBACK__:methodNameParameterCompletion
```

**Case 4: Just words (no display)**
```
WORD: method1
WORD: method2
WORD: method3
```

## **🔧 DO**

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Format display lines (TypeScript decides WHAT to show - single or multiple)
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix (bash will detect if single word)
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`WORD: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:, TRIGGER:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)

---

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words display word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display lines
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger (special WORD value)
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word = auto-complete with trailing space
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words = use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~30 lines. TWO grep commands (display + words), uniform logic for ALL cases.**

### **Grep One-Liners**

**Extract display:**
```bash
echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-
```

**Extract words:**
```bash
echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-
```

**That's the ENTIRE parsing logic. Two one-liners. Uniform for ALL cases.**

**Objective:** ONE-LINE grep protocol - TypeScript prefixes lines, bash greps them

**SIMPLEST Protocol Design:**

### **TypeScript Output Format**

**Prefix Convention:**
- `DISPLAY: <text>` - User-visible hierarchical output (bash shows, then strips)
- `WORD: <word>` - Completion word (bash extracts for compgen)
- `TRIGGER: <trigger>` - Special trigger (bash detects)

## **🔧 DO**

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Format display lines (TypeScript decides WHAT to show - single or multiple)
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix (bash will detect if single word)
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`WORD: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)
- ✅ bash logic UNIFORM for all cases (single/multiple/callback)

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words display word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display lines
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger (special WORD value)
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word = auto-complete with trailing space
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words = use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~30 lines. TWO grep commands (display + words), uniform logic for ALL cases.**

### **TypeScript Output Format**

**Prefix Convention:**
- `DISPLAY: <text>` - User-visible hierarchical output (bash shows, then strips)
- `WORD: <word>` - Completion word (bash extracts for compgen)
- `TRIGGER: <trigger>` - Special trigger (bash detects)

## **🔧 DO**

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Format display lines (TypeScript decides WHAT to show - single or multiple)
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix (bash will detect if single word)
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`WORD: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)
- ✅ bash logic UNIFORM for all cases (single/multiple/callback)

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words display word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display lines
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger (special WORD value)
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word = auto-complete with trailing space
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words = use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~30 lines. TWO grep commands (display + words), uniform logic for ALL cases.**

## **📋 PLAN**

**Objective:** ONE-LINE grep protocol - TypeScript prefixes lines, bash greps them

**SIMPLEST Protocol Design:**

### **TypeScript Output Format**

**Prefix Convention:**
- `DISPLAY: <text>` - User-visible hierarchical output (bash shows, then strips)
- `WORD: <word>` - Completion word (bash extracts for compgen)
- `TRIGGER: <trigger>` - Special trigger (bash detects)

**Example Outputs:**

**Case 1: Multiple methods with display**
```
DISPLAY: 🔍 Filtered methods (3):
DISPLAY:   1: completion <what> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   2: completeParameter <name> <method> <param> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   3: comp <args>
WORD: completion
WORD: completeParameter
WORD: comp
```

**Case 2: Single match**
```
DISPLAY: 🔍 Single match found: completion <what> <?filter>
DISPLAY:   Returns completions for method names or parameter values
WORD: completion
```

**Case 3: Callback needed**
```
WORD: __CALLBACK__:methodNameParameterCompletion
```

**Case 4: Just words (no display)**
```
WORD: method1
WORD: method2
WORD: method3
```

## **🔧 DO**

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Format display lines (TypeScript decides WHAT to show - single or multiple)
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix (bash will detect if single word)
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`WORD: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)
- ✅ bash logic UNIFORM for all cases (single/multiple/callback)

---

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words display word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display lines
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger (special WORD value)
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word = auto-complete with trailing space
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words = use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~30 lines. TWO grep commands (display + words), uniform logic for ALL cases.**

```

**Extract words:**
```bash

```

**That's the ENTIRE parsing logic. Two one-liners. Uniform for ALL cases.**

### **TypeScript Output Format**

### **TypeScript Implementation**

**File:** `components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.14.2/src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Simple completion output:**

```typescript
async completion(what: string = '', filter: string = ''): Promise<this> {
  if (what === 'method' || what === '') {
    const methods = this.getAvailableMethods(filter);
    const methodNames = methods.map(m => m.name);
    
    // Format display lines (TypeScript decides WHAT to show - single or multiple)
    if (methodNames.length > 0) {
      const formattedLines = this.formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods, filter);
      // Output each display line with DISPLAY: prefix
      formattedLines.forEach(line => {
        console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
      });
      
      // Output each word with WORD: prefix (bash will detect if single word)
      methodNames.forEach(name => {
        console.log(`WORD: ${name}`);
      });
    }
  } else if (what === 'parameter') {
    const values = this.getParameterValues(filter);
    
    // Check if callback needed
    if (this.needsCallback(filter)) {
      console.log(`WORD: __CALLBACK__:${filter}ParameterCompletion`);
      return this;
    }
    
    // Output parameter values
    values.forEach(value => {
      console.log(`WORD: ${value}`);
    });
  }
  
  return this;
}

// Helper: Format methods as array of lines (no ANSI in TypeScript!)
private formatMethodsHierarchicalLines(methods: any[], filter: string): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  if (filter) {
    lines.push(`🔍 Filtered methods (${methods.length}):`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`📋 Available methods (${methods.length}):`);
  }
  
  methods.forEach((method, index) => {
    const signature = this.formatMethodSignature(method);
    lines.push(`  ${index + 1}: ${signature}`);
  });
  
  return lines;
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ No flags (--lines, --display, etc.)
- ✅ No markers ([DISPLAY], [/DISPLAY])
- ✅ Simple prefixes (DISPLAY:, WORD:)
- ✅ One grep line extracts what bash needs
- ✅ TypeScript decides format (method controls output)
- ✅ bash logic UNIFORM for all cases (single/multiple/callback)

### **bash Implementation**

**Entire completion function (~20 lines!):**

```bash
_web4tscomponent() {
    local cur prev cmd result words display word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Get completion from TypeScript
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Handle timeout
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display lines
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger (special WORD value)
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word = auto-complete with trailing space
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words = use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}

complete -F _web4tscomponent web4tscomponent
```

**That's it. ~30 lines. TWO grep commands (display + words), uniform logic for ALL cases.**

### **4. source.env - `_web4_tscompletion()` function**

**Current:** 442 lines with complex parsing  
**Target:** ~20 lines with 3 grep commands

**New implementation:**
```bash
_web4_tscompletion() {
    local cur prev cmd result display words word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Call TypeScript (timeout wrapper)
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word auto-complete
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words - use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}
```

## **bash Changes Required**

### **4. source.env - `_web4_tscompletion()` function**

**Current:** 442 lines with complex parsing  
**Target:** ~20 lines with 3 grep commands

**New implementation:**
```bash
_web4_tscompletion() {
    local cur prev cmd result display words word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # Call TypeScript (timeout wrapper)
    result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completion method "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && { printf "\n⏱️  Timeout\n" >&2; return 0; }
    
    # Extract and show display
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # Extract words for compgen
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # Handle callback trigger
    if [[ "$words" == __CALLBACK__:* ]]; then
        local callback="${words#__CALLBACK__:}"
        result=$(timeout 30s "$cmd" completeParameter "$callback" "$prev" "$cur" 2>/dev/null)
        display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
        [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
        words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    fi
    
    # Single word auto-complete
    word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
    [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ] && { COMPREPLY=("$words "); return 0; }
    
    # Multiple words - use compgen
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
}
```

**Lines:** ~30 (vs 442 = 93% reduction!)

- Callback handling (3 locations) → Single callback check
- Single-match detection (regex parsing) → `wc -w` count
- ANSI stripping (sed commands) → Not needed (TypeScript outputs clean)

### **Step 3: Modify source.env (Bash Side)**

**File:** `source.env`

**Add after line ~40 (in `_web4_tscompletion()` function):**

```bash
_web4_tscompletion() {
    local cur prev cmd result words display word_count
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    cmd="${COMP_WORDS[0]}"
    
    # ... existing code ...
    
    # NEW: Extract DISPLAY lines (show to user)
    display=$(echo "$result" | grep "^DISPLAY: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    [ -n "$display" ] && printf "\n%s\n\n" "$display"
    
    # NEW: Extract WORD lines (for compgen)
    words=$(echo "$result" | grep "^WORD: " | cut -d' ' -f2-)
    
    # NEW: Single word auto-complete detection
    if [ -n "$words" ]; then
        word_count=$(echo "$words" | wc -w | tr -d ' ')
        if [ "$word_count" -eq 1 ]; then
            COMPREPLY=("$words ")
            return 0
        fi
        
        # Multiple words - use compgen
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$words" -- "$cur"))
    else
        # Fallback to old behavior (for non-migrated methods)
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$result" -- "$cur"))
    fi
}
```

async completeParameter(callbackName: string, ...contextArgs: string[]): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof (this as any)[callbackName] === 'function') {
    const values = await (this as any)[callbackName](contextArgs);
    
    // NEW: Output with WORD: prefix
    if (Array.isArray(values) && values.length > 0) {
      // Check if values are already formatted (numbered lines)
      const hasNumberedRefs = values.some((v: string) => v.match(/^\d+:/));
      
      if (hasNumberedRefs) {
        // Complex format (method completion) - add DISPLAY: and WORD:
        values.forEach((line: string) => console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`));
        // Extract method names for WORD:
        const words = values.map((line: string) => line.replace(/^\d+:\s*/, '').split(' ')[0]);
        words.forEach((word: string) => console.log(`WORD: ${word}`));
      } else {
        // Simple format (parameter values) - just WORD:
        values.forEach((word: string) => console.log(`WORD: ${word}`));
      }
    }
  } else {
    console.log('');
  }
}

/**
 * Format completion values with DISPLAY/WORD protocol
 * Handles both simple arrays and complex formatted output
 * @cliHide
 */
private formatCompletionOutput(values: string[]): void {
  // Detect complex format (numbered lines like "1: methodName <params>")
  const hasNumberedRefs = values.some((v: string) => v.match(/^\d+:/));
  const hasSpaces = values.some((v: string) => v.includes(' '));
  
  if (hasNumberedRefs || hasSpaces) {
    // Complex format: numbered method list
    // Output as DISPLAY lines
    values.forEach((line: string) => console.log(`DISPLAY: ${line}`));
    
    // Extract method names for WORD lines
    const words = values.map((line: string) => {
      const match = line.match(/^\d+:\s*(\S+)/);
      return match ? match[1] : line.split(' ')[0];
    });
    words.forEach((word: string) => console.log(`WORD: ${word}`));
  } else {
    // Simple format: plain words
    values.forEach((word: string) => console.log(`WORD: ${word}`));
  }
}

/**

 * Handles both simple arrays and complex formatted output
 * @cliHide
 */
private formatCompletionOutput(values: string[]): void {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  
  // Detect complex format (numbered lines like "1: methodName <params>")
  const hasNumberedRefs = values.some((v: string) => v.match(/^\d+:/));
  const hasSpaces = values.some((v: string) => v.includes(' '));
  
  if (hasNumberedRefs || hasSpaces) {
    // Complex format: Add DISPLAY lines
    values.forEach((line: string) => {
      lines.push(`DISPLAY: ${line}`);
    });
    
    // Extract method names and add WORD lines
    values.forEach((line: string) => {
      const match = line.match(/^\d+:\s*(\S+)/);
      const word = match ? match[1] : line.split(' ')[0];
      lines.push(`WORD: ${word}`);
    });
  } else {
    // Simple format: Just WORD lines
    values.forEach((word: string) => {
      lines.push(`WORD: ${word}`);
    });
  }
  
  // ONE console.log for entire block!
  console.log(lines.join('\n'));
}
